news_summary: Anthropic's S-1 shows Amazon's $6.2 billion in convertible notes were valued at $97.9 billion on June 30, while no venture firm reaches the 5% threshold for the principal stockholders table.
payoff: Amazon is likely the single largest financial beneficiary of Anthropic's IPO.
